source: results/phase4/4b_res30.npz (production, res 30; res 40 confirmation arrays carry the suffix _res40)
sign_convention: MEEP exp(-i omega t), MEEP_SIGN = +1: a delay tau multiplies a monochromatic signal by exp(+i 2 pi f tau); tau_g = +d arg H / d omega; ideal TTD channel relative to channel 0: H_m/H_0 = exp(+i 2 pi f m dtau_target); array factor AF = sum_m H_m exp(-i k0 x_m sin(theta)) (pcttd.array)
H_definition: H_m(f) = S21_m = a_f(out)/a_f(in), guided-mode amplitudes at x = -3 and x = N_m + 3 of the directly simulated D0 device with N_m periods; includes the full propagation phase over N_m + 6 periods; nothing de-embedded; channel 0 is the reference for relative phases
H_trim_definition: H_trim_m = H_raw_m exp(-i trim_delta_m); trim_delta_m = raw phase error at f0 (one frequency-independent constant per channel; amplitude and group delay untouched)
labels: H_raw = raw PhC; H_trim = phase-intercept-trimmed PhC (never call either ideal TTD)
common_band_definition: 4b_res30.json bands.primary_poly_tol10 (see report for the final gate band)
restrictions: quantitative claims only inside mask_validated_domain (0.231-0.268, post hoc Phase 2 validation limit)
delay granularity: one period ~ one carrier cycle
pointwise delay/GDD from H is noise-limited
